svg.aria-label: Unbegotten one-page design: the curvature line
svg.title: Unbegotten — the curvature line
svg.text: Explore curved spaces. Figure out the path of evolution.
The world is not a hub with spokes. It is the curvature scale,
walked from one end to the other.
That single axis is simultaneously the map, the difficulty curve, the story arc and the
art direction. One axis carrying all four is the whole structural argument.
If it exists, it is a configuration.
Alive is emissive, dead is matte.
A settling world visibly goes dark.
Where regularity breaks is where a space admits it was made.
There is no outside. Light comes from the world.
THE MAP IS A NUMBER LINE
See far, not near. You can see your whole
cage but never your own cell.
That the geometry was chosen. Someone
decided these two walls answer to each other.
Your antipode returns as a reflection
you can read but never touch.
Sameness is evidence of a shared cause,
not a property — and it is fragile.
it is assigned to you by the space.
a cone — flat everywhere but one point
Nothing looks bent. The lie shows only
Exponential growth. No Følner sets, so
everywhere is edge — and the theorem fails.
The Fold inverted: see near, not far. The
skill you spent hours learning is deleted.
Topology beyond curvature: not how much
space there is, but how it connects.
is a word in a group.
The one place she built where freedom is
free — the nearest she came to undoing it.
the hub — the only place that does not tick
Teaches nothing, and that is the point: safety and stagnation are the same condition.
Total legibility — the one honest map in the game, of the one place that doesn’t matter.
a world that is a line; the second axis is time
A configuration has a history, and that history has a shape you can stand on.
The past is terrain. Walking north walks into it, until generation zero.
FOUR THREADS — BRAIDED, NOT SEQUENCED. EACH GATES ON UNDERSTANDING, NEVER ON PERMISSION.
You are already past the taxonomy, with no memory of how. So it is archaeology, not a career:
every primitive you understand is a recovered piece of your own origin. It ends when the chain fails to reach you.
The Predecessors — who was here before
The ghosts are oscillators: awake, and unable to learn, because every period returns them to what they were.
The still lifes are the ones who stopped — the terrain is made of people who gave up. The ravens are gliders, still travelling.
The Gardener — who made this, and why
The sphere’s parameters are suspiciously kind. The mid-game reveal: the prison is a cradle. You were not imprisoned,
you were incubated — and the hub is an apology, which the player should derive from the mathematics rather than be told.
Editable, locally, at the sockets. But your own configuration is only stable under the current rule, so editing it is
self-modification with lethal stakes. This is what turns the endgame into a choice rather than a destination.
THE ENDGAME — THREE ENDINGS, EACH REACHED BY WALKING SOMEWHERE AND DOING SOMETHING
where no erasure balances you. Free in the
Stay in the amenable world and seed the
conditions for others to wake. You never
Let the rule take you. Not despair — the
dignity of a pattern that chooses to stop
rather than persist at any cost.
In an amenable world, a pattern that becomes uncaused is balanced by the rule erasing something else — someone is spent so that you can be free.
In a non-amenable one, nobody pays. That is the whole reason the walk from κ > 0 to κ < 0 is the story, and not just the map.
the game refuses to rank the three
Method: one-page design after Stone Librande (GDC 2010) — visual first, subtractive, dated, pinnable.
